attributes.name: Akhil Johri
attributes.blurb: EVP and CFO of United Technologies Corporation (2015 - 2019)
attributes.summary:
Johri served as EVP and CFO of United Technologies Corporation from 2015 until late 2019. He returned to United Technologies after serving close to two years as CFO for Pall Corporation. 

Previously, he spent 26 years at United Technologies in various executive positions, most recently as VP of Finance and CFO for UTC Propulsion and Aerospace Systems, which included Pratt & Whitney and UTC Aerospace Systems.
